name: roadmap-ciso-app
description: Aplicativo de estudo interativo para o roadmap CISO
author: Daniel Gabriel

scripts.build: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run check:questions && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts
scripts.distribuir: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.distribuir:linux: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.distribuir:win: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.distribuir:mac: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.verificar: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:desktop && npm run smoke:pasta && python3 ../conteudo/scripts/verificar-repo.py
scripts.verificar:pacote: npm run distribuir && npm run smoke:pacote
scripts.desktop: npm run preparar:conteudo && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.preparar:conteudo: npm run build:content && npm run check:content && npm run build:questions && npm run check:questions
